articles.title: Albert Cifuentes, 67, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Albert Cifuentes for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow. Albert Cifuentes died in May at home on Mulberry Road, at the age of 67.

Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Albert Cifuentes spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Millrace Improvement Group in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: the Millrace Youth Center Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Please keep the senior exercise class in the budget. Many of us on Eaton Street use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.

To the editor: I have lived on Eaton Street for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Dominic Kozak, Mill Hill
